key_insight: CoPiT explicitly conditions geometry-based attention features on global parameters to improve aerodynamic field prediction on unstructured meshes.
engineering_relevance: This surrogate could reduce reliance on expensive RANS solves during aerodynamic design exploration, optimization, and multi-condition evaluation.
method: Uses a Position-induced Transformer backbone for unstructured-mesh geometry.
Injects global operating and design conditions through multi-stage feature-wise linear modulation (FiLM).
Preserves geometry-based attention weights while modulating intermediate features.
evidence_signal: Evaluated on 2D AirfRANS and 3D BlendedNet++, CoPiT reduces AirfRANS full-data surface and volume losses by approximately 54% and 24% versus Transolver and achieves the lowest overall normalized test MSE among compared BlendedNet++ baselines.
watch_item: The preferred FiLM placement is task-dependent, so conditioning stages may require tuning for each application.
paper_title: CoPiT: A conditional Position-induced Transformer for aerodynamic field prediction on unstructured meshes
